primary_family: 18 behavioral SEM paths plus 8 health coefficients; joint Holm correction applied by the combined-family script
case_selection: Modelwise complete cases. Symptoms and distress restrict A10 to 1 or 2; heat uses all farmers. All covariates categorical. Constant controls omitted only in descriptive subgroup fits.
joint_sensitivity: All fourteen observed summaries, E10 and Country/A1-A11 complete; current-user restriction retained for pesticide outcomes.
matching_profile_sensitivity: One numerical profile representative retained for influence assessment; matching answers do not establish duplicated participants.
primary_heat: Binary E10>0, any dizziness/faintness in past farming season. Ordinal PO sensitivity retains all three response categories and is qualified by correlated-score threshold diagnostics.
symptom_coding: E1-E4: 0 no, 1 yes, 2 yes more than once; past three months after handling. Mean is a defined category-recurrence summary, not event count, dose or poisoning diagnosis. E5 ever medically attended poisoning is separate.
distress_coding: E13-E15 past week, each 0-3. Mean is study-specific distress summary, not DASS diagnosis or clinical severity threshold.
inference: All analyses exploratory; nominal robust intervals. Holm controls the designated combined focal family, not model-selection uncertainty or diagnostic/sensitivity tests.
country_heat: No ordinary-MLE country-specific heat inference is reported; sparse nuisance categories can generate boundary estimates.
